python3 -c "
# Values from FFO-4 tables (in millions of dollars)
fy_2011 = 135030  # Department of Labor total outlays FY 2011
fy_2019 = 35810   # Department of Labor total outlays FY 2019

print(f'FY 2011 value: {fy_2011}')
print(f'FY 2019 value: {fy_2019}')
print(f'Number of years: {years}')

# CAGR = ((end/start)^(1/years) - 1)
cagr = (fy_2019 / fy_2011) ** (1 / years) - 1
print(f'\\nCAGR = ((end/start)^(1/years) - 1)')
print(f'CAGR = (({fy_2019}/{fy_2011})^(1/{years}) - 1)')
print(f'CAGR = {cagr}')

# Annual decay factor = 1 + CAGR

print(f'\\nAnnual decay factor = 1 + CAGR = {decay_factor}')

"
